other_conditions: Only two children from one family are eligible
Parents must be engaged in unclean/hygienic occupations such as Scavenger, Flayers, or Tanner, or have left those occupations after 1997
Applicant must not be eligible for any other state scholarship
Eligibility category noted in source: Other deprived categories
benefits_summary: Students studying in Class 1‑10 receive a scholarship of ₹1,850 per annum.
